```{r}
# Clear environment
rm(list = ls())
ls()

# Load dataset
data <- read.table("5EST220-DataReagente.txt", header = TRUE)
head(data)
attach(data)
```

Assumption checking (CRD)

```{r}

# Linear model treating x as a factor (for residual analysis)
fit1 <- lm(y ~ factor(x))
res <- fit1$residuals
res

# Normality test
shapiro.test(res)

# Homogeneity of variances
bartlett.test(res, x)
```

Fitting a quadratic regression model

```{r}
# Scatterplot
plot(x, y, pch = 19, col = "red", main = "Scatterplot: Response vs. Dose")

# Quadratic model
fit2 <- lm(y ~ x + I(x^2))
summary(fit2)

# Coefficient of determination
R2 <- summary(fit2)$r.squared; R2
anova(fit2)
coef(fit2)
confint(fit2)
```

**Model Equation:**

*𝑌= − 0.2774 + 0.0323𝑋−0.000089𝑋\^2*

Residual Sum of Squares = 3.6021 Includes both pure error and lack of fit

### Pure error and lack of fit analysis

```{r}
# Fit using x as a factor to capture pure error
fit3 <- lm(y ~ factor(x))
summary(fit3)
R2max <- summary(fit3)$r.squared; R2max
anova(fit3)

# Lack of fit test (comparing quadratic to full model)
anova(fit2, fit3)
anova(fit1, fit2)
```

**Results:**

- RSS (fit2): 3.6021 (27 df) -Pure Error: 2.9267 (20 df) -Lack of Fit: 0.6754 (7 df), F = 0.6594, p = 0.7031 → Not significant

```{r}
# Real R-squared
R2real <- R2 / R2max
R2real
```

Using ExpDes.pt for Analysis

```{r}
library(ExpDes.pt)

# Quantitative analysis
dic(x, y, quali = FALSE, mcomp = "tukey", sigT = 0.05, sigF = 0.06)

# Polynomial regression with known degrees of freedom and SS
dic <- lm(y ~ factor(x))
anova(dic)

reg.poly(y, x, 20, 2.9267, 9, 7.3430)
```

Plotting the Fitted Quadratic Model

```{r}
# Plot observed values
plot(y ~ x, data = data, pch = 16, col = "blue",
     xlab = "Dose X", ylab = "Response Y", ylim = c(0, 3),
     xaxt = "n", frame = FALSE)
axis(1, xaxp = c(50, 300, 10))  # custom ticks

# Add fitted curve
cf.m <- coef(fit2)
curve(cf.m[1] + cf.m[2]*x + cf.m[3]*I(x^2), add = TRUE, col = "red", lty = 1)

# Annotate with equation and R²
co <- format(c(coef(fit2), R2real), digits = 4)
text(160, 0.8, label = substitute(
  hat(y) == b0 + b1*x + b2*x^2 ~~~~ (R^2 == r2),
  list(b0 = co[1], b1 = co[2], b2 = co[3], r2 = co[4])))
```
